## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 42400ef32d3644fe1632f4c0f3f9d299c49c6bc6

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit reverts encoding-related property names (`OUTPUT_ENCODING`→`OUT_ENCODING`, `SOURCE_ENCODING`→`IN_ENCODING`, methods `getOutputEncoding`/`getSourceEncoding`→`getOutEncoding`/`getInEncoding`) across `IReportProperties.java`, `ReportProperties.java`, and the html/txt/xml `ReportGenerator.java` files. I searched history with `git log -S"OUTPUT_ENCODING"` to find when these symbols were introduced, which pointed to commit `42400ef` ("fixed the source code encoding issue").

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `42400ef` replaced the pre-existing, working `OUT_ENCODING` property (`"out.encoding"`) with two new properties labeled "addition parameters by terry": `OUTPUT_ENCODING` (`"html.outputEncoding"`) and `SOURCE_ENCODING` (`"html.sourceEncoding"`). It removed the original `setOutEncoding`/`getOutEncoding` accessors entirely and rewired all output-stream-opening call sites (HTML, TXT, XML report generators) to use `getOutputEncoding()` instead. It also added mandatory `$assert.ASSERT` checks requiring `m_sourceEncoding` and `m_outputEncoding` to be non-null after parsing, and it added a new encoding-based file reader for source files using `getSourceEncoding()` (previously a plain `FileReader` with no explicit encoding).

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The diff of `42400ef` is essentially an exact mirror image of the bug-fix diff in `d4074e2` — every hunk that the fix reverts corresponds line-for-line to a hunk that `42400ef` introduced (same property key changes, same method renames, same call-site changes in the three `ReportGenerator` classes). This strongly indicates `42400ef` is what introduced the regression that `d4074e2` fixes: it changed the documented/expected `report.out.encoding` property into a differently-named, non-standard property key (`html.outputEncoding`), broke backward compatibility with any existing configuration using `out.encoding`, and added strict null assertions on encoding fields that are only populated via `getReportProperty(..., false, false)` (optional, no default), risking `AssertionError`s when the new properties aren't set.

I have high confidence in this identification since the fix commit's diff is a near-exact inverse of `42400ef`'s diff, with no other commits touching these encoding symbols in between (confirmed via `git log -S` covering all history).
